Authored-words budget gauge

Requirements

The system MUST persist every recorded split to local storage so that splits survive an application restart, including when the device was offline at the time the split was taken.

The display MUST advance the seconds value monotonically and MUST flip from fifty-nine to zero cleanly at each minute roll without flickering the previous value for a frame.

The export routine SHOULD format split timestamps in the user's current locale at render time rather than storing pre-formatted strings, so that a timezone change does not corrupt historical records.

The settings panel SHOULD remember the last-selected lap mode across sessions and SHOULD restore it on launch without requiring the user to reconfigure it each time.
